headline: SILVER ROCKETS 2.4% TO $76 — Gold/Silver Ratio Compresses to 59x as Physical Market Enters Sixth Annual Deficit
snippet: Silver surged to $76.24/oz on May 21, up $1.81 (+2.41%) on the day, as physical buyers stepped in aggressively following a sharp 7% drawdown the prior week. The gold/silver ratio compressed to roughly 59x — its tightest reading in weeks — while the Silver Institute confirms 2026 is on track for a sixth straight structural supply deficit, with fabrication and investment demand once again exceeding total mine production and recycling.

headline: IRAN SUPREME LEADER KILLS NUKE DEAL: Gold Tests $4,500 Floor, Copper Retreats on Collapsed Peace Hopes
snippet: Gold fell to $4,524/oz on May 22 (-0.42%) after Iran's Supreme Leader issued a directive ordering the country's uranium to remain on Iranian soil, blocking a US-Iran nuclear agreement that had briefly lifted risk assets. Copper reversed earlier gains made on peace deal optimism; oil prices surged back toward four-year highs on renewed conflict fears, adding fresh inflation pressure to an already skittish macro backdrop.

headline: Collective Mining Traces 700-Metre Oxide Gold-Silver Zone at Northern Apollo — 71.2m at 1.95 g/t AuEq From Surface
snippet: Collective Mining (TSX: CNL) announced discovery of a new oxidized gold-silver corridor at Northern Apollo within its Guayabales Project in Caldas, Colombia: 700m strike length, 200m width, beginning at surface and traced to 100m depth, grading 1.95 g/t AuEq (0.75 g/t Au, 87 g/t Ag) over 71.2m in the leading hole. With US$113M in cash and 14 drill rigs targeting up to 100,000m in 2026, the company is positioned to drill this discovery aggressively.

headline: GR SILVER'S BEST-EVER HOLE: 45.1m at 1,623 g/t Ag — Including 8.25m at 8,579 g/t Ag at San Marcial, Mexico
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSX-V: GRSL) reported its strongest-ever drill intercept at the San Marcial SE Area of its Plomosas Project in Sinaloa, Mexico: hole SMS26-04 hit 45.1m at 1,623 g/t silver, including an exceptional 8.25m at 8,579 g/t Ag. The result significantly eclipses all prior intercepts from the ongoing 20,000m step-out campaign, with two rigs currently on-site and more in transit.

headline: Troilus Expands Near-Pit West Rim Zone: 2.92 g/t AuEQ Over 19m Outside Resource — Analysts Flag Quebec Project as M&A Target
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG) released the first 2026 West Rim drill results at its copper-gold project in northcentral Quebec, hitting 1.97 g/t AuEq over 20m and 2.92 g/t AuEq over 19m — all entirely outside the current mineral resource but within 200m of the North Reserve Pit from the 2024 feasibility study. The Northern Miner reports analysts are flagging near-pit grade continuity and the project's infrastructure-ready position as growing acquisition catalysts.

headline: Juggernaut Fires Up 10,000-Metre Inaugural Drill in BC's Golden Triangle — District-Scale Au-Ag-Cu System at Big One
snippet: Juggernaut Exploration (TSX-V: JUGR) has mobilized for its fully funded 10,000m inaugural drill campaign at the Big One property in British Columbia's Golden Triangle. The program targets newly discovered district-scale gold, silver, and copper shear-hosted vein systems across the 22 km² Eldorado zone — the first systematic drill test of a system flagged by Crescat Capital.

headline: MinersAI AI-Powered Exploration Platform Launches in Asia-Pacific — First APAC Client Deployments Underway
snippet: MinersAI, an AI platform designed to reduce exploration risk through geological data synthesis and drill-target generation, has expanded into the Asia-Pacific region with its first APAC client deployments now active. The launch signals growing institutional appetite for AI-assisted targeting as junior miners seek to lower per-ounce discovery costs in a high-overhead environment.

headline: WHY $5,000 GOLD IS STILL THE BASE CASE — Institutions Hold Year-End Targets Despite 16% Pullback From $5,589 January High
snippet: Gold's 16% retreat from its January 2026 all-time high of $5,589/oz to current levels near $4,500 has not moved major institutional price targets: Goldman Sachs sees $5,400 by December, Bank of America $6,000, and J.P. Morgan $6,300 with an $8,000 tail scenario. Persistent central bank accumulation and US fiscal deterioration are cited as structural supports that make the current consolidation a buying window, not a trend break.

headline: Cochilco Raises 2026 Chile Copper Forecast to $5.55/lb — AI Data Centres and Energy Transition Demand Holds Firm
snippet: Chile's state copper commission Cochilco raised its 2026 average copper price forecast to $5.55/lb, citing demand resilience from AI data-centre buildout, electric vehicles, and global energy transition infrastructure. The commission sees prices staying elevated at $5.10/lb in 2027; simultaneously, Codelco is pursuing $2B in cost reductions as the world's largest copper miner battles flat output and rising debt.

headline: Gold Miners Up 164% vs Bullion's 60% in 2025 — Analysts See Leveraged Upside Returning at Current $4,500 Buy Zone
snippet: The FTSE Gold Mines Index advanced 164% in 2025 against physical gold's 60% gain, and analysts argue the same operational leverage is re-emerging at current prices. With producers generating record free cash flow above $4,500/oz and the sector still trading at a discount to historical P/NAV multiples, gold equities are re-entering institutional conversations as the preferred leveraged gold play.
